_comment: English catalogue. Keys missing here fall back to Turkish (tr.json).
Mod_Dashboard: Your system at a glance, with what you can do about it.
Mod_Cleaner: Finds leftovers from Windows, browsers and applications. You decide what gets deleted.
Mod_Registry: Finds dead registry entries with 12 separate scanners. Every change is backed up first.
Mod_Drivers: Reads your hardware and finds outdated drivers. Sources are Microsoft and the vendor's official channels only.
Mod_Updates: Finds newer versions of installed programs through winget and updates them in bulk.
Mod_Startup: Everything that runs at boot, in one list. Impact is not a guess — it is the real delay Windows measured.
Mod_Programs: Uninstalls programs. Sizes are not estimates; install folders are actually measured.
Mod_DiskHealth: S.M.A.R.T. data from your drive: temperature, remaining life, total bytes written — in plain language.
Mod_DiskAnalysis: What is eating your space? Treemap, largest files and a duplicate finder.
Mod_Timeline: A record of every change made to your system. Go back to any point with one click.
Mod_Settings: Theme, language, scheduled tasks, quarantine retention and advanced options.
Ob_Lang_Subtitle: We read your Windows language and chose for you. Change it if you like.
Ob_Lang_Note: Translation is still in progress. Screens that aren't translated yet appear in Turkish; they switch over on their own as translation lands.
Ob_Modules_Subtitle: Nine modules sit on the left. Each does exactly one job, and none of them work behind your back.
Ob_Safety_Title: Anything you delete can come back
Ob_Safety_Subtitle: This is the app's most important promise. It has three layers:
Ob_Safety_1_Body: Deleted files aren't gone for good; they're kept for as long as you choose and restored with one click.
Ob_Safety_2_Body: Cleaning, registry, drivers, startup — every change in one chronological stream. Go back to any point.
Ob_Safety_3_Title: If we're unsure, we don't touch it
Ob_Safety_3_Body: When we can't be certain a file or entry is truly unneeded, it never makes it onto the list.
Ob_Privacy_2: No usage data is collected and nothing is sent to any server.
Ob_Privacy_3: No ads, no upsell to a paid tier. The source code is open.
Ob_Privacy_4: Your settings and logs stay on this machine only.
Ob_Ready_Subtitle: Start a scan from the Dashboard. Scanning deletes nothing — it only shows you what's there.
Ob_Ready_Admin: Running as administrator frees up more: the Windows Update cache, system temporary files and disk health data all require it.
Set_Subtitle: No account, no telemetry, no ads. Every setting here applies to this machine only.
Set_Theme_Desc: The system option follows your Windows light/dark setting instantly.
Set_Language_Desc: The automatic option uses your Windows language. Untranslated text appears in Turkish.
Set_RestorePoint_Desc: Taken before registry cleaning and driver installation. Turning this off isn't recommended: it's a second safety net, independent of the app's own backups.
Set_Retention_Desc: Deleted files are kept for this long and can be restored from the Timeline. Once the period is over they are permanently deleted.
Set_Weekly_Off: Off. When enabled, only rules marked safe run; every deletion goes to quarantine and can be undone.
Set_Weekly_NeedsAdmin: Run the app as administrator to create a scheduled task.
Set_Weekly_NoCli: The command line build (sysscrub-cli.exe) wasn't found in this installation.
Set_Hour_Desc: The task won't run on battery, and a missed run is made up once the computer is on again.
Set_Portable: Portable mode: all data lives in the app's own folder and nothing is written to the system.
Set_NotPortable: Data is kept in the shared application data folder.
Set_License: MIT licence · no account · no telemetry · no ads
Cl_Subtitle: Scanning deletes nothing. You decide what goes from the list; deleted files land in quarantine and can be restored.
Cl_AdminNote: Without administrator rights some system rules are skipped.
Cl_CancelNote: If you cancel, whatever was deleted up to that point stays in quarantine and can be restored.
Db_NoAdminBody: The Windows Update cache, system temporary files and driver operations all need it — and those usually free the most space.
Tl_Subtitle: A record of every change made to your system. Cleanups that went to quarantine can be undone from here.
Dr_Subtitle: Updates come from Windows Update — every driver from there is WHQL-signed and cleared by Microsoft for this hardware.
Dr_UpdateTip: Installation arrives in phase 4, together with download, signature verification, backup and rollback.
Dr_BackupTip: Exports every third-party driver. Requires administrator rights.
Up_Subtitle: Finds newer versions of installed programs through winget. Every package is downloaded from its own publisher's source.
Up_Empty: Press Check and your installed programs are compared against winget's sources.
Up_CancelNote: Cancelling doesn't interrupt an installation in progress; it only stops the packages queued after it.
St_Subtitle: Disabling doesn't delete the entry — Windows' own mechanism is used, so it can always be undone and stays in sync with Task Manager.
St_MissingTip: The file this entry runs no longer exists. Windows looks for it at every boot for nothing.
St_DelayTip: The average startup delay Windows measured for this entry in its Diagnostics-Performance log.
St_Empty: Registry Run entries, startup folders, logon-triggered scheduled tasks and automatic services are listed together.
Pr_Subtitle: The program's own uninstaller does the work. The result is verified by checking whether the entry actually disappeared — the exit code isn't reliable.
Pr_ComponentTip: Windows hides this entry: a runtime, a patch or a component.
Pr_NoUninstallerTip: The uninstaller file wasn't found. The program still looks installed but can't be removed from here; its entry needs cleaning by hand.
Pr_ComponentsTip: Runtimes, patches and other entries Windows keeps hidden.
Pr_Empty: Uninstall entries and the Store package repository are read. Install folders are measured in the background; the size column isn't an estimate but a real, scanned value.
Pr_MoveToBinTip: Not deleted permanently; if it's the wrong folder you can restore it from the Recycle Bin.
Pr_CancelNote: The uninstaller may open its own window. Cancelling won't close one that's already open; it only stops the ones queued after it.
Dh_Subtitle: Data is read from the drive itself; nothing is written to it. A drive that can't be read doesn't vanish from the list — the reason is shown instead.
Dh_AdminNote: Reading S.M.A.R.T. data means sending commands to the drive, which requires administrator rights. Open the app as administrator and the health data appears.
Dh_Empty: The NVMe health log and the ATA S.M.A.R.T. table are read straight from the drive. Temperature, total bytes written, remaining life and spare block status all show up here.
Dh_ReadingBody: Sending a health query to each drive…
Da_Subtitle: Read-only: no file is deleted or opened. Cloud files aren't downloaded — since they take no space on disk, they aren't counted either.
Da_FindDuplicatesTip: Finds files over 1 MB with identical content. First by size, then by a content sample, and only then a full comparison.
Da_MoveExtrasTip: The first copy is always kept. Not a permanent delete — you can restore from the Recycle Bin.
Da_Empty: Each block is a folder or a file, sized in proportion to what it takes up. Click a block to go inside it. The duplicate finder locates identical copies and moves the extras to the Recycle Bin.
Rg_Subtitle: Finds registry entries whose target has disappeared. Every finding states why it's considered dead, so you can see before deleting.
Rg_SafetyTitle: Two safety nets are set up before anything is deleted
Rg_SafetyBody: A .reg backup is taken for every entry to be removed and a system restore point is created. If the backup fails, nothing is deleted.

Rs_FileExtensions_Desc: Every file extension points to a program type (ProgID). When a program is uninstalled the extension entry sometimes stays behind and points at a type that no longer exists. Windows then doesn't know what to do when you double-click the file.
Rs_ProgIdClsid_Desc: A program type points to the COM component that opens it. If the component isn't registered the type doesn't work either, and the entry just sits there.
Rs_ComServers_Desc: COM components point to the DLL or EXE that provides them. If the file was deleted the component doesn't work; the entry only takes up space and stalls programs looking for it.
Rs_TypeLibraries_Desc: Type libraries describe how to call COM interfaces. A library entry whose file was deleted is of no use at all.
Rs_ShellExtensions_Desc: The approval list for components that hook into File Explorer's context menu and previews. Entries from removed programs stay here and Explorer looks for them at every start.
Rs_UninstallEntries_Desc: The entries that feed the Programs and Features list. If the uninstaller was deleted the entry still shows up but can't be removed — it fails with "this program has already been uninstalled".
Rs_SharedDlls_Desc: Programs count the libraries they share here. When a program is uninstalled the counter sometimes stays behind. Entries whose file no longer exists serve no purpose.
Rs_AppPaths_Desc: When you type a short name into the Run box ("chrome", for example) Windows looks the program up here. When a program is uninstalled the entry sometimes stays and the short name points at a path that doesn't work.
Rs_StartupEntries_Desc: Windows tries to run the programs in these entries at boot. If the program was deleted it's searched for in vain every time. Clearing them speeds up boot a little.
Rs_MuiCache_Desc: Windows stores the display names of programs you've run here. Entries from deleted programs stay and pile up over the years. Clearing them affects nothing.
Rs_InstallerFolders_Desc: Windows Installer lists the folders it installed into here. When a folder is deleted the entry stays and accumulates over time.
Rs_SoundEvents_Desc: Sound files assigned to system events. When the file is deleted the event goes silent but the entry remains. Clearing it only removes the dead entry, it doesn't affect working sounds.
